title: Computational AlPO$_{4}$-5 Structure
comments:
This is a computational prediction of the structure of microporous AlPO$_{4}$-5.  It is somewhat different than the experimental \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_hP72_184_d_4d_d-001}{AlPO$_{4}$-5 framework}. 
 A list of AlPO$_{4}$ polymorphs in the Encyclopedia can be found on our \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{SiO$_{2}$ and AlPO$_{4}$ page}. 
 We have updated the bibliographic information for this page (2025).
